sources.purpose: Products, files and public product JSON for a Gumroad automation
sources.reliability_limits: Fetched page was truncated after variants; sales/webhook sections need a separate read.

learnings.claim: The official Gumroad API docs (fetched 2026-10-09) state that POST /v2/products publishes the product immediately unless draft=true or published=false, that PUT /v2/products/:id with files, tags or rich_content replaces the whole collection (omitted files are deleted), and that /v2/files/complete must not be retried because an upload_id works only once.
learnings.decision: GUMROAD_DRAFT_FIRST_GATE: any automated product create must send draft=true and wait for Furkan's approval before PUT /enable; product updates must resend every existing file id+url or omit files entirely; on a lost /files/complete response restart from /files/presign, never retry complete.
fallback_history: Without an OAuth token use the unauthenticated public /l/:permalink.json endpoint for read-only price/rating monitoring.
learnings.next_measurement: When a Gumroad token exists, create one draft product and read it back to confirm published=false before any further automation.
learnings.title: Gumroad create publishes immediately and PUT files replaces all

learnings.claim: The official Gumroad API docs (fetched 2026-10-09) describe GET https://[seller].gumroad.com/l/:permalink.json as a public endpoint needing no authentication that returns display data (price_cents, ratings, is_published, options) and never seller-private or analytics fields; sales_count is null unless the creator shows it.
learnings.decision: GUMROAD_PUBLIC_MONITOR_PATH: read-only monitoring of a published product can start now via the public .json endpoint without secrets; do not infer sales from it (sales_count null means hidden, not zero).
learnings.next_measurement: Pick one live product permalink from Furkan and record a daily price/rating snapshot.
learnings.title: Gumroad public product JSON needs no auth
